items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: It was George Washington on trombone, and he had Faiso on drums.

ctx.x: This is February the 14th, 1970. Yes, Ray. And we're interviewing Tester Zardes, and we're in Preservation Hall. Yes, Ray. All right, Tester, well, one of the main things I wanted to ask you about was when you were playing in Over the Lake, in the early 20s or whenever it was, with Buddy Petit. Yeah, 19, 20, that's right. Okay, well, now, can you tell me everything you can remember about that, how you met Buddy and what way you would play and who else was in the band and generally all kinds of things like that. I…

Well, you see, the way we started off, I was playing with a band out of, you know, around here in town until I got professional. I didn't get professional until I got with Buddy's band, you know what I mean? And Buddy had a pretty nice band. It was George Washington on trombone, and he had Faiso on drums. Then you had Edmund Hall on clarinet, and Buddy Petit was playing the trumpet. See? We didn't have, but there were six pieces, you know? Yeah. You know? And this boy, Hall, Hall was a pretty nice, you know, nice…
